audience: C# developers, reviewers and teams using coding agents
policy: samples/100-expenseguard/.csassay.json; exact digests recorded with each fixture

claims.wording: Selected admitted immutable-carrier findings can be inspected and explained offline.
claims.limits: init is shallow; selected shapes are not universal purity.
claims.requalify: Example, analyzer, compiler, policy or package identity changes

claims.wording: Simulated approval advice does not bypass ExpenseGuard's missing-receipt rule.
claims.scope: Synthetic authenticated HTTP/PostgreSQL cases around the USD receipt threshold
claims.owner: Domain policy and required application tests
claims.limits: Offline simulation; business requirements are not inferred by Roslyn.
claims.requalify: Domain, facts, tests, policy, application or toolchain changes

claims.wording: An external receipt assertion differs from server-verified stored bytes.
claims.owner: Domain, receipt storage and HTTP/PostgreSQL tests
claims.limits: Bytes/hash do not prove authenticity, itemization or malware safety.
claims.requalify: Receipt, policy, API or persistence changes

claims.wording: The normal authenticated API rejects self-approval in the guided case.
claims.requalify: Roles, authorization, transition or API changes

claims.wording: Native-union exhaustiveness and CSAU0004 advice have different authority.
claims.owner: C# compiler CS8509; separate prototype analyzer observation
claims.requalify: Compiler, analyzer, language settings or specimen changes

claims.wording: Changing a declared web asset invalidates a previously bound application receipt.
claims.owner: BuildEvidence and a disposable current-build probe
claims.limits: Trusted local hash binding, not remote attestation; viewer NotAvailable is not an engine enum.
claims.requalify: Assemblies, declared assets/configuration or reader changes

claims.wording: A registered offline repair is independently checked within a two-round budget.
claims.scope: One isolated structural specimen, no live model
claims.owner: Protected-input validation, actual builds and verifier
claims.negativeControl: round-1; protected-policy-edit; stale-feedback; malformed-feedback; no-progress; budget-exhausted
claims.limits: No business tests configured for this structural specimen; not model-quality or productivity evidence.
claims.requalify: Repair, feedback, protected inputs, verifier or compiler changes

claims.wording: A recorded scoped badge links source-bound completed evidence.
claims.owner: Existing completed receipt and local binding; summary consumer
claims.negativeControl: stale-source; absent-authority; failed-tests; incomplete; hostile-svg; output-failure
claims.limits: Not current-main monitoring or correctness/security certification.
claims.requalify: Source/report binding, policy, tests, projection or output changes
